Company description: NKE (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

Nike, Inc. (NKE) is a global leader in the design, development, marketing, and distribution of athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories. Headquartered in Beaverton, Oregon, the company operates as one of the world’s most recognizable brands, supported by its iconic "Swoosh" logo and the "Just Do It" slogan. Nike manages a diverse portfolio that includes the Nike brand, Jordan Brand, and Converse.

The company was founded in 1964 as Blue Ribbon Sports by Bill Bowerman and Phil Knight, initially operating as a distributor for Japanese shoemaker Onitsuka Tiger. It officially rebranded as Nike, Inc. in 1971, drawing inspiration from the Greek goddess of victory. Since its inception, Nike has revolutionized the sports industry through continuous innovation in performance technology and strategic partnerships with elite athletes. Today, the company maintains a massive international presence, leveraging a sophisticated supply chain and a robust direct-to-consumer digital strategy to maintain its competitive edge in the global sportswear market.
